tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (Haze) behind every page and section.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, top navigation, inputs, table rows, hero band.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Soft fills inside cards: stat boxes, neutral tags, progress track, selected list row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, row dividers, nav bottom border. Decorative only, never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and the toggle track (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and headings, on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions, on bg, surface and surface-2 (5.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ink Blue. Primary buttons, links, current nav item underline, focus ring, progress fill. As text on bg, surface, surface-2 and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary buttons.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: 'Due today' chip, step numbers, habit glyph tiles, avatar.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover fills (8.5:1).

tokens.name: met
tokens.usage: Status Met / Within limit: chip text and border, Met cells in the consistency strip. Always with a label or the solid-cell shape.

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: Status Failed: chip text and border, Failed cells. Always with a label; never told apart from met by colour alone.

tokens.name: missed
tokens.usage: Status Missed: same hue as failed, shown hatched in the strip and labelled 'Missed'.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Deactivate account, Reject) and form errors.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Status Pending (inside the 48 h grace period): text on pending-soft.

tokens.name: pending-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Pending chips and Pending strip cells.

tokens.name: excused
tokens.usage: Status Excused: dashed outline chip and dashed strip cell.

tokens.name: paused
tokens.usage: Paused strip cells (fill only, no text on it).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs (Record, Add note, Excuse, End goal).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Visitor home hero headline only. 34px on phones.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Habit and goal names in cards, step titles.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Consistency and streak values; the count '(18 of 20)' follows in small.

styles.name: stat-small
styles.usage: Percentages in goal lists and band summaries.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Set a goal to build or reduce a habit.
styles.usage: Default text, table cells, form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in rows, labels, nav links.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase label above a card title. Write it uppercase in CSS (text-transform), not in the text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small buttons; stat box gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding (top/bottom), gap between tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, grid gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Container side gutter; gap between card columns.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chips and status chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, stat boxes, glyph tiles, selected rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, notices, tables.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatar, step numbers, toggle, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card and the hero example card. Cards also keep a 1px line border.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Menus and dropdowns that float over content.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content inside the full-width nav and hero bands.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Height of the top navigation bar.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of default buttons and inputs; small buttons are 32px.
